recommendation: Keep the source fix. It completes the FHIR-27149 documentation request without changing subscription semantics; revisit only if the work group wants a stable registry deep link or registry-owned instructions instead of spec-page guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-27149 was Published and resolved Not Persuasive with Modification: registry.fhir.org would automatically support known SubscriptionTopics, but the subscriptions documentation should point readers there and explain how to search it.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly cited FHIR-27149. The original registry pointer appears to have been applied through grouped subscription documentation work, especially commit 77b1c1d6 for adjacent FHIR-27148, which added a Finding Subscription Topics registry paragraph to subscriptions.html. Later SubscriptionTopic notes also encouraged publishing and checking registry definitions.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists Subscription and SubscriptionTopic, so the edited framework and resource-note pages are current-build source. FHIR-43508 later revisited registry discovery, concluded registry support was working but few topics had been published yet, and added the early-adoption note that remains adjacent to this guidance. A 2022 Zulip thread similarly reflected scarcity rather than a conflicting policy.
reconciliation: Restored the finding-topics anchor, switched the framework-page registry link to HTTPS, added concise guidance to search by topic title or canonical URL and filter matching contents to SubscriptionTopic instances, and linked the SubscriptionTopic authoring notes back to that guidance.
source_changes: source/subscriptions.html: restored the finding-topics anchor, changed the registry link to HTTPS, and added registry search/filter guidance for SubscriptionTopic instances.
source/subscriptiontopic/subscriptiontopic-notes.xml: linked registry publication/check guidance to the Finding Subscription Topics section.
